Find the sum and average of all elements in a list.

Supplied answer
nums = [10, 20, 30, 40]
total = 0
for num in nums:
    total += num
print("Sum =", total)
print("Average =", total / len(nums))
print("Built-in:", sum(nums), sum(nums) / len(nums))
Note: Guard against an empty list, otherwise len(nums) is 0 and you get ZeroDivisionError.
